User-agent: *
Allow: /

Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /profile-edit
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /care
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /expert

Sitemap: https://florup.localhost/sitemap.xml
```

#### `frontend/public/sitemap.xml`

  </url>
  <url>

  </url>

  </url>
  <url>

  </url>

  </url>
</urlset>
